pictures.scene: Gottlieb, Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur — the whole congregation crowded in under the stone arches of the synagogue on the holy day, the men below wrapped in white and black striped prayer shawls, one bent over the open book on the reading desk with his hand to his ear, another with his hand pressed hard to his forehead, a bearded man in a tall fur hat carrying the mantled scroll in both arms with its star and its Hebrew lettering, a boy in a flowered coat standing at the front looking out at us, and the women leaning over the gallery rail above in silver head-cloths and fur-trimmed red and green, now the feast of unleavened bread, called the passover, was approaching, …
pictures.name: pd_gottlieb_jews_praying_on_yom_kippur

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Judas Returning the Thirty Pieces of Silver — inside the dark temple hall a man has thrown himself on his knees on the stone floor, wringing his hands together and bowing his head almost to the ground before the priests, his hair torn out at the front and his coat hanging off one shoulder, the high priest in a purple robe and a gold sash turning away from him with one hand pushed out, an old man with a white beard and others in fur hats crowding in behind to stare at him, a great gold lamp hanging down out of the shadows above, and the silver coins lying scattered in a little heap on the boards at the front of the picture, and judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray jesus to them, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_judas_returning_the_thirty_pieces_of_silver

pictures.scene: Reymerswaele, The Tax Collectors — two men lean in close over the ledger in a cramped back office hung about with papers, the one in the great red fur hat and the blue gown bent right down over the open book with spectacles pinched on his nose and a pen in his ringed hand, writing the sum in, the other behind him in a green cap grinning sideways out of the picture with his face all creased up, one finger pointing down at the page and the other hand closed over the coins, the brown coins and a little pair of scales lying about on the table, and above them a shelf of rolled papers, a candlestick and a brass dish, they were delighted and agreed to give him money, …
pictures.name: pd_reymerswaele_the_tax_collectors

pictures.scene: Zurbaran, Agnus Dei — a young white ram lying on its side on a plain stone slab in the dark, nothing else in the picture at all, the light falling only on the thick curled fleece and on the long pale face laid flat along the stone, the eye half shut, the nose soft and pink, one heavy horn curving back around the ear and the other over the crown of the head, and all the rest of the picture black behind it, then came the day of unleavened bread on which the passover lamb was to be sacrificed, …
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_agnus_dei

pictures.scene: Velazquez, The Waterseller of Seville — an old water carrier in a torn brown cloak stands in the dark with one hand round the great pale water jar in front of him, the clay of it ribbed and beaded with wet, his other hand holding out a glass of water across the top of it, a boy in a white collar taking the glass with both hands and looking up at him, a third man drinking behind them with his face half lost in the shadow, and a second jar standing on a stool at the left, he answered, when you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you, follow him to the house he enters, …
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_waterseller_seville

pictures.scene: Ancher, Sunlight in the Blue Room — an upstairs room in strong afternoon sun, the whole left wall painted deep blue with the shape of the window thrown across it in white and pale blue light, the tall window at the back hung with gold curtains and standing open onto the day, a mirror and a corner cupboard beside it, a bare wooden floor with the sunlight lying along the boards in yellow stripes, chairs standing about a little work table, and in the middle of it all a fair-haired girl in a blue dress sitting with her head bent over the sewing in her hands, and he will show you a large upper room, already furnished, make preparations there, …
pictures.name: pd_ancher_sunlight_in_the_blue_room

pictures.scene: Bouts, Christ in the House of Simon — the Lord sits at the end of a trestle table in a stone room with one hand raised in blessing and His head bowed, a long dark robe, His bare feet showing under the table, the white cloth spread with round loaves, a green glass and a fish on a pewter dish, the bearded host in a blue jewelled cap and a yellow gown leaning in at His side, an open colonnade at the left looking out over a river and fields, and on the floor at the front a woman in red and green and blue bowed right down with her face almost on the tiles, drying His feet with her long loose hair, her little jar standing beside her, when the hour had come, jesus reclined at the table with his apostles, …
pictures.name: pd_bouts_christ_in_the_house_of_simon

pictures.scene: Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — the Lord sits alone on a low grey rock in a wide stony desert at first light, hunched forward with His shoulders drawn up and His head bent, His hands locked hard together on His knees, a heavy dark blue-grey cloak pulled round Him over a dull red robe, His bare feet set flat on the cold broken stone, the pale pink and cream of the dawn spread along a low bank of cloud behind Him, and nothing else in the whole picture but the grey shattered rock running away to the edge, and he said to them, i have eagerly desired to eat this passover with you before my suffering, …
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, The Red Vineyard — a whole hillside of vines burning red and orange under a yellow evening sky, the pickers bent double among the rows in blue and green smocks, one woman carrying a flat green basket on her head, another standing upright with a bundle of cut bunches, a man in a blue coat stooping low over the plants with both hands in the leaves, a horse and cart waiting at the top of the slope beyond a band of flat gold field, dark blue trees along the skyline, and a wet track at the front of the picture running down between the vines with the light lying on it in grey and red streaks, for i tell you that i will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of god comes, …
pictures.name: pd_gogh_wijngaard

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Supper at Emmaus — the Lord sits at the middle of a white-clothed table in a dark room, beardless and young, His long hair falling loose, a red tunic under a white shawl, one hand thrown out wide over the table in blessing and the other held low above the loaves, His eyes cast down at the bread, His shadow thrown huge on the brown wall behind Him, an old man at the right with a bald head and a grey beard leaning in with both hands lifted in astonishment, another man's arm and shoulder pressing in at the left edge, and spread along the cloth in front of them a roast bird on a painted dish, a torn white loaf, a glass of dark wine, and a basket of grapes, pomegranates and pears tipping out over the very edge of the table, and he took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, this is my body, given for you, do this in remembrance of me, …
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_supper_at_emmaus

pictures.scene: Juanes, The Last Supper — the Lord sits at the middle of the long white table in a pillared hall, holding up a round white wafer in His right hand and laying His left on His breast, a violet robe and a red cloak, a gold cup standing on the cloth in front of Him, an arched opening behind His head looking out on a blue-green evening country with a house and a hill, Peter at His right in green and rose with his white beard turned up towards Him and his hand on his chest, the young John at His left in a green coat staring at Him open-mouthed, more disciples crowding in at the edges with their hands flung up and their fingers pointing, their names written round their gold haloes, the loaves and the knives and a little salt cellar laid along the cloth, and under the table their bare feet on the chequered floor beside a great brass basin and a gold ewer, look, the hand of him who betrays me is with mine on the table, …
pictures.name: pd_juanes_last_supper

pictures.scene: Brouwer, Fighting Peasants — a quarrel broken out in front of a village alehouse under a bare forked tree, a man in a blue cap and a grey jacket and yellow breeches pulled round by the arm with his face twisted and his mouth open and a knife dragged half out at his belt, a woman in a white head-cloth and a red skirt hanging onto his wrist with both hands and shouting up into his face, another man behind them in a brown fur cap bawling over his shoulder, more faces crowding in at the right over the trestle boards with the brown jugs and a red crock standing on them, and away beyond the hill a little church tower and the low roofs of the village in the grey afternoon, a dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be the greatest, …
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_fighting_peasants

pictures.scene: Martin, Belshazzar's Feast — the king's banquet spread out in a vast Babylonian court at night, the long table at the front covered in white and heaped with gold cups and dishes and piled fruit, a crimson cloth hanging to the floor and more gold vessels standing about on the pavement, the women of the court in white and rose and gold thrown back from the table with their arms flung up and their faces turned away, one man in a dark robe standing straight up in the middle of them with his arm out and his finger pointing, torches and a burning altar away on the left with a gilt idol above it, tier upon tier of colonnades and stairways going up behind them full of little figures, and over it all a storm of black smoke rolling across the sky past the lit face of a great stepped tower, the kings of the gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors, …
pictures.name: pd_john_martin_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Garofalo, Christ Washing the Disciples' Feet — the Lord down on one knee on the pale stone floor in a red robe with a white towel tied round His waist, His rayed gold halo behind His bent head, both hands in the water of a shallow brass basin holding the foot of the white-haired old man seated above Him, the old man in a blue tunic drawn back with one hand pressed flat against his own breast and his bearded face turned down at Him in protest, a heavy orange cloak falling over the step beside him, and behind them the other disciples pressed together in green and red and dark blue with their gold haloes overlapping, one old man with a long white beard leaning on the shoulder of the man in front of him, another young and fair-haired watching over them, and the plain stone wall of the hall going up above their heads, but i am among you as one who serves, …
pictures.name: pd_garofalo_christ_washing_the_disciples_feet

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — a woodcut all in black line, the Almighty enthroned at the top of the sheet with a long forked beard and a sword and a book, seven burning lamps hanging in the air round His head, a lamb standing up on the step of the throne, the four living creatures with their many wings below, and ranked all round the sky on their own high seats the crowned elders in their robes, some holding out little harps, some lifting their gold crowns off their heads in both hands, one of them leaning down out of the clouds to take the kneeling John by the arm and draw him up, John on his knees on a bank of rolling cloud with his hands together and his head bent back, rays of light driving out past the cloud on every side, and far below under it all a quiet German valley with a walled town, a tower, a mill by the water and dense round trees, so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of israel, …
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Courbet, The Wheat Sifters — a young countrywoman kneeling on the floor of a bare farm room with her back to us, a strong red dress and a yellow kerchief across her shoulders, her sleeves rolled above the elbow, both arms out wide holding up a great round brown sieve and shaking it so that the grain hisses out in a spray of gold across the pale boards beside her, her dark hair twisted up and her face turned down in lost profile, her shoes kicked off behind her, another woman at the left bent low over a wide shallow dish on the floor, bowls and a wooden tub standing along a plank bench behind, a child in dark clothes at the right by the bench, and the old cracked plaster wall going up pale and bare above all of it, simon, simon, satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat, …
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_wheat_sifters

pictures.scene: Ter Brugghen, The Liberation of Peter — a prison at night, the old apostle half risen from the straw in a blue-green jacket and a great fall of yellow cloak, his white beard thrown up and his mouth open and his eyes turned straight up out of the top of the picture, one bare foot still stretched on the ground and the chain hanging from his wrist, a young angel in a white and blue striped sleeve and a yellow robe stooping over him from the right with one hand laid on his shoulder and the other arm raised high with the fingers spread, the dark wing lifting behind the angel's head, and a soldier in a steel helmet asleep at the left with his cheek dropped onto his own hand, lord, i am ready to go with you even to prison and to death, …
pictures.name: pd_brugghen_liberation_of_peter

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog — a traveller standing alone on the top of a broken crag with his back to us, a long dark green coat, his fair hair blown about, one hand on his hip and the other closed round the walking staff planted on the rock beside him, nothing under him but the white fog lying in the valley in great slow banks and pouring between the stones, the dark heads of other rocks and a little stand of pines breaking up through it, pale blue ridges going back on both sides, a square tower of stone standing up far off on the right, and above it all a wide cool sky streaked with thin high cloud, when i sent you without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything, …
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — the archangel standing astride on a burnished gold ground in a full suit of gilded plate armour with mail at the throat and the knees, his young face calm and his eyes lowered, his right arm swung back over his head gripping a long straight sword by the hilt, his left hand resting on the rim of a round crystal shield, a scarlet cloak with a jewelled gold border blowing out wide behind him on both sides, his wings spread in bands of gold and orange and red, and under his gilded shoes the scaly body of the dragon with its horned head and red eyes and open red mouth full of teeth, while a man in a tall black hat and a grey patterned gown kneels small at the left with an open book in his hands, looking up at him, look, lord, here are two swords, that is enough, he answered, …
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_zwaard

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Olive Trees — a little grove of old olives on a slope, their trunks bent and twisted and knotted over on themselves in dark blue and brown, the branches writhing out sideways, the leaves laid on in short curved strokes of blue and grey-green with bright green leaves flicked in among them, a white sky broken up by the tops of the trees, a few orange and red touches among the roots where the fruit has fallen, and the whole ground of the orchard running away towards us in long wavering stripes of rust red and yellow and pale green and blue, then jesus went out as usual to the mount of olives, and the disciples followed him, …
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_olive_trees

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Agony in the Garden — the Lord kneeling alone on the bare ground in a rose-coloured robe that spills out all round Him over a fallen blue cloak, both arms opened wide and low with the palms turned up, His face lifted and His eyes turned up and sideways out of the picture, a brown rock rising straight up behind His head like a tent, thin dry bushes growing out of the slope at His right, and the strange pale clouds of the night curling in at both edges of the picture and parting over the rock, father, if you are willing, take this cup from me, yet not my will, but yours be done, …
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_agony_in_the_garden

pictures.scene: Bloch, Gethsemane — the Lord kneeling on a flat rock in the olive garden at night in a deep red robe, His head fallen forward and His eyes shut and His hands locked together on His knee, and an angel kneeling close beside Him in white with great pale wings folded down the whole length of her back, her arms round Him and her cheek laid against the side of His head and her own hands closed over His, a gnarled old olive trunk and its torn branches standing up behind them, a little grass and a few red flowers at the edge of the rock, and all the rest of the picture black night, then an angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him, …
pictures.name: pd_bloch_gethsemane

pictures.scene: Anker, Sleeping Boy in the Hay — a boy stretched out flat on his back asleep in the cut grass beside a wooden barn wall, his head turned over on the hay and his mouth a little open, one arm flung out wide behind him, a white shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brown waistcoat and loose blue trousers, one bare foot thrown out towards us with the sole turned up and the trouser leg ridden back off the ankle, his flat straw hat dropped on the grass beside his shoulder, and nothing above him but the dark brown boards and the door post of the barn, when jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow, …
pictures.name: pd_anker_slaap

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Taking of Christ — a close press of heads and hands in the dark, the Lord in a red robe over a dark blue cloak with His head bowed and His brows drawn together and His eyes cast down, His own two hands locked together low in front of Him, the heavy bearded traitor pushed right up against His cheek with one hand gripping Him hard by the shoulder and his face thrust forward into His, a soldier in black polished armour reaching past them both with an armoured arm thrown across the Lord's throat and a bare hand coming in at the lower corner, another man in green crying out behind with his mouth open and his arm flung up, and a great fold of dark red cloak lifted over all their heads, judas, are you betraying the son of man with a kiss, …
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_taking_of_christ

pictures.scene: Vrancx, Soldiers Plundering a Farmhouse — armed men broken into a farm kitchen and the whole household in uproar, a long gun barrel levelled in from the left edge straight at a woman in a white cap and a red skirt who has turned with her mouth open and her arm thrown back, a small child in white beside her with both hands up in the air crying out, a man on his knees on the floor in orange at the front with his face turned up and his hands spread, another man in a black coat and a white sash running for the open door at the right with his hat on and his mouth wide open, and behind them the quiet things of the house going on standing where they were, the spinning wheel, a basket hung on the wall, strings of onions by the hearth, a brush and a bunch of keys, and the great timbers of the roof above, lord, should we strike with our swords, …
pictures.name: pd_vrancx_soldaten_plunderen_een_boerderij

pictures.scene: Giotto, The Kiss of Judas — a fresco on a deep blue ground, the Lord held fast in the middle of the crowd with a gold halo round His head and His face in strict profile, perfectly still, and the traitor pressed up against Him face to face, wrapped in a great yellow cloak that he has swung out and closed round the Lord's shoulders like a net, the two of them staring into each other's eyes, a captain in a red cloak and a gold tunic shouldering in from the right with his arm out and his finger pointing, soldiers in black fur hoods and grey hoods crowding both sides, one man at the left seen from behind in a lilac cloak, bare feet on the brown ground below, and above all their heads the whole sky crossed and recrossed with raised clubs and staves and two burning torches, have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw, …
pictures.name: pd_giotto_the_kiss_of_judas

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Night Watch — an armed company turning out of a dark gateway into the night, the whole upper part of the picture a great brown wall of stone in shadow with a shield hung high on it, long pikes and lances crossing the dark at every angle, the captain in black with a broad black hat and a wide white ruff and a blood red sash across his chest stepping forward with his gloved hand thrown out and open, his lieutenant beside him in pale yellow and gold with a steel gorget at his throat and a white sash knotted at his waist, a helmeted musketeer behind them blowing the powder off his pan, another lifting his long gun across the group, faces in steel helmets and plumed hats crowding the shadow on both sides, and one burst of lamplight falling on the gold and the white linen while everything behind them sinks away into darkness, but this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_night_watch

pictures.scene: La Tour, The Tears of Saint Peter — an old bald bearded fisherman sitting alone in a dark room in a heavy blue-black robe, his two hands locked hard together in his lap, his mouth open and his head turned up and away into the dark with the wet track of a tear shining on his cheek, one shoulder lifted where the cloak falls back, a glass lantern standing on the floor at his feet throwing the only light there is, a low table behind him with a bowl and a cloth on it, and everything else in the picture gone into brown shadow, and when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, peter sat down with them, …
pictures.name: pd_latour_peter

pictures.scene: Honthorst, The Denial of Saint Peter — three faces lit by one candle in a black room, a servant girl at the left in a white headcloth with her mouth open and her eyes turned up and sideways, a soldier in a steel helmet and a white and green striped doublet standing between them with a pike in his fist and his other arm stretched right across to lay a hand on the old man's chest, and the old fisherman at the right in a heavy ochre cloak pulled close, white bearded, his head drawn back and his chin lifted, one hand spread flat and open in front of him in protest, a dark sleeved arm coming in at the left edge with the finger pointing at him, and a brass candlestick held up from below out of sight, but peter denied it, woman, i do not know him, he said, …
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_the_denial_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Hondecoeter, Hen, Chicks, Doves and Peacocks — a farmyard corner under the trees painted feather by feather, a great white bird settled low on the bare ground with a scarlet comb and scarlet wattles and a yellow beak, dark blue tail feathers folded up behind her and one yellow chick tucked in under the curve of her breast with only its head out, a sooty black chick pecking the dirt in front of her and two more chicks huddled together at the right, loose white feathers lying in the dust, a slate blue and green pigeon perched on a broken block of stone at the left with a rose coloured dove beside it, a peacock and peahen stepping along the bank at the right, and beyond them a gap in the dark foliage opening on a pale evening sky, and immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed, …
pictures.name: pd_hondecoeter_hen_chicks_doves_and_peacocks

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Tears of Saint Peter — a grey haired fisherman standing outside in the half dark with his face turned straight up, his eyes swimming and reddened and brimming over, his mouth a little open and his white beard lifted, wrapped in a heavy gold yellow cloak thrown over a deep blue green robe, his two weathered hands clasped tight together in front of his chest and the fingers interlocked, two big iron keys hanging from a cord at his wrist, sprays of ivy trailing down the rock on either side above his head, and a cold grey light breaking in low at the left behind him while all the rest goes brown and dark, and he went outside and wept bitterly, …
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_saint_peter_in_tears

pictures.scene: Bosch, Christ Mocked — four heads pressed close together against a plain grey wall, the Lord in the middle in a pale robe with long red brown hair and a short beard, a ring of long thorns pushed down round His head, His face perfectly calm and His eyes turned out of the picture straight at whoever is looking, and four hands laid on Him at once, a man at the upper left in a green turban stuck through with an arrow and a steel gauntlet on his shoulder, a man at the upper right with oak leaves and an acorn pinned to his cap and a spiked dog collar round his neck, leaning in with his face screwed up, an old man at the lower left in red gripping a stave, and one more hand in a red sleeve closing on the Lord's arm, then the men who were holding jesus began to mock him and beat him, …
pictures.name: pd_bosch_christ_mocked

pictures.scene: Van der Valckert, The Regents of the Merchants Guild — a board of men sitting in judgement in a dark panelled room, two of them close up behind a table covered with a thick patterned carpet in black and orange, both in plain black coats and broad black hats with wide stiff white ruffs standing out under their beards, both looking straight out of the picture with level unsmiling eyes, one holding a quill over a sheet of paper beside a black inkstand, the other with one hand flat on the table and the other laying a finger on an open document covered with close writing, a heavy ledger lying open at the left with a third man's hand resting on the page, and a brass balance on iron chains hanging down between their heads with both pans empty, at daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together, …
pictures.name: pd_valckert_regents_kramergild

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — the Lord seated high in the middle of a great blue oval ring set with small winged heads, robed in pale blue and white with a gold bordered collar, a gold cross marked in the halo behind His head, one hand raised with the fingers open and the other reaching out to the side, rays of beaten gold and red seraph wings spreading out behind the throne, the whole ground of the picture burnished gold scored with fine lines running outward like light, an angel standing below the ring holding up a tall thin cross, ranks of haloed saints and angels pressing in at both edges with their hands joined, and a crowd of small blue winged heads banked under His feet like cloud, but from now on the son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of god, …
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Massys, Salvator Mundi — the face of the Lord filling the whole picture, looking straight out and level at whoever stands in front of it, dark brown hair parted in the middle and falling long past His shoulders, a short brown beard, the eyes steady and unblinking and faintly shadowed, a halo of beaten gold behind His head worked all over with fine punched rays, a deep red robe fastened at the throat with a jewelled gold clasp set with dark stones and pearls and edged with gold embroidery, His right hand lifted at the edge of the frame with two fingers raised in blessing, and the gold rim of an orb showing under His left hand at the bottom corner, are you then the son of god, and he said to them, you say that i am, …
pictures.name: pd_metsys_salvator_mundi

lines.text: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people.
Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.
Where do You want us to prepare it? they asked.
He answered, When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
and say to the owner of that house, The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?
And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.
So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.
When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.
And He said to them, I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, Take this and divide it among yourselves.
For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.
And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.
In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.
Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.
So Jesus declared, The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.
Lord, said Peter, I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.
But Jesus replied, I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.
Then Jesus asked them, When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything? Nothing, they answered.
Now, however, He told them, the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: And He was numbered with the transgressors. For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.
So they said, Look, Lord, here are two swords. That is enough, He answered.
Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
When He came to the place, He told them, Pray that you will not enter into temptation.
And He withdrew about a stone's throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.
Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.
And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
Why are you sleeping? He asked. Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.
While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
But Jesus asked him, Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?
Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, Lord, should we strike with our swords?
And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
But Jesus answered, No more of this! And He touched the man's ear and healed him.
Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.
Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. This man also was with Him, she said.
But Peter denied it. Woman, I do not know Him, he said.
A short time later, someone else saw him and said, You also are one of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.
About an hour later, another man insisted, Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.
Man, I do not know what you are talking about, Peter replied. While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.
And he went outside and wept bitterly.
The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, Prophesy! Who hit You?
And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.
At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
If You are the Christ, tell us. Jesus answered, If I tell you, you will not believe. And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
So they all asked, Are You then the Son of God? He replied, You say that I am.
Why do we need any more testimony? they declared. We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.
